I prefer to pre-calculate everything and add that to the plot. You are probably looking for geom_vline or geom_hline (http://docs.ggplot2.org/current/geom_vline.html).

messages.author: c0d7452abd52e973
messages.subject: Re: Mean Dashed Line Boxplot
parts:
data(iris)
p <- ggplot(iris, aes(x=as.numeric(Species), y=Sepal.Length)) + 
  geom_boxplot(aes(x=Species)) + 
  stat_summary(geom='line', fun.y="mean", color='red', linetype=2)
p

This is a reproducible example, I think this is what you want.
